nodes.name: Choose Campaign

parameters.content:
## Read-only campaign review
1. Set campaignId in Choose Campaign.
2. Select your Bearer Auth credential in all 3 MCP Client nodes.
3. Run manually and download the Markdown output.

Exactly one campaign, first 50 recent activity events and first 50 upcoming tasks. More pages are disclosed, not fetched. No LLM, send or write nodes.

Raw node responses may contain personal data. Execution saving is disabled in this template; check your instance retention and access policies. Tested with n8n 2.35.7 using a local fictional MCP server, not a production workspace.

[Setup and report example](https://www.outreachgenie.ai/blog/n8n-linkedin-campaign-review) · [MCP authentication](https://www.outreachgenie.ai/developers)

Requires your own OutreachGenie workspace, an existing campaign and n8n. This workflow does not collect new prospects or send messages. Contributed by OutreachGenie with AI assistance under this repository's CC BY 4.0 licence; no affiliation with n8n.
